name: jira
title: Jira Cloud API
description: Issues, projects, sprints, boards, comments, and workflows for Jira Cloud.
notes: Requires JIRA_EMAIL (your Atlassian email) and JIRA_API_TOKEN from id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Also set base URL: the spec defaults to api.atlassian.com — your instance URL may differ.
